summary: Frontend-only testing of the 4 new ERP 3.0 features: CSV Import, Onboarding Tour, Owner PIN Fast Path, GST Filing Timeline. 3 of 4 features work end-to-end. Onboarding Tour breaks after the first Next click because <OnboardingTour/> is mounted inside ErpHub and unmounts when the tour navigates away from /vendor/erp. CSV import, PIN unlock (both modes + persistence), PIN change form, and GST timeline (12 cells, chips, year switcher, preview pill) all verified. Regression: ERP Hub still shows 20 tiles + 3-min tour button; Products page still has both Import CSV and Add Product buttons.

ui_bugs.issue: Tour breaks after step 1. <OnboardingTour/> is rendered only inside ErpHub.jsx (line 89). When the tour navigates from /vendor/erp to /vendor/erp/billing (step 2), ErpHub unmounts, taking OnboardingTour and its React state (step index, running flag) with it. Result: after clicking Next once, the tour card and spotlight disappear at /vendor/erp/billing, /vendor/erp/inventory and /vendor/erp/reports. tour-next / tour-finish selectors were not found from step 2 onwards. Because Done is never reached, localStorage 'sc.erp.tour.completed.v1' never gets set, so the tour re-auto-opens on every fresh visit to /vendor/erp.
React hydration/DOM warning: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Caused by Emergent's x-source wrapper spans injected inside <option> — likely non-blocking but worth noting.

onboarding_tour.steps_2_5_broken: See ui_bugs — tour unmounts because ErpHub is left

pin_change_on_security_page.mismatch_and_short_pin_paths_reached_ui: Toasts not captured by selector (sonner auto-dismiss), but form guards exist in code (submitPin)

critical_code_review_comments: OnboardingTour placement bug — must be mounted at Layout/App level (or reuse a portal) so it survives route changes; current implementation guarantees the tour breaks the moment the user leaves the Hub, which is exactly what step 2 does (see STEPS[1].route = /vendor/erp/billing). The useOnboardingTour hook + <OnboardingTour/> need to live in a top-level component (e.g. Layout or a route-persistent context provider) so `running` / `step` state survives navigation.
useOnboardingTour has no way to clear the completed key from within the app UI — only via manually clearing localStorage; consider adding a 'Restart tour' entry-point that also clears the key.

GstFilingTimeline sampleTimeline still emits a 'DUE' status only if today.getMonth() === monthIdx + 1 && today.getFullYear() === y — this is only true one month per year and the FY math (Apr-start) plus year param mean the current month rarely shows amber. In the current fabricated sample for FY 2026 we see 0 'Due' months. Consider forcing one DUE cell so the preview demonstrates all four states.

ProductCsvImport commit loop swallows every saveProduct error silently (catch {}). If ALL rows fail the toast still says 'Imported 0 of 1 products' with no differentiation. Consider surfacing error count in the toast.

OwnerLockGate does not actually distinguish PIN vs password on the backend when both endpoints 404 — any 4-digit input unlocks. This is expected in preview mode but should be documented for the eventual backend contract.

success_rate.frontend: 80% (4 of 5 subtests fully pass; tour steps 2-5 broken)

Verify: (a) tour survives navigation through all 5 steps, (b) tour-finish sets sc.erp.tour.completed.v1, (c) reload no longer auto-opens tour, (d) manual replay via [data-testid=tour-start-btn] still works. rca_of_the_issue: OnboardingTour is a child of <ErpHub/>. STEPS[1].route === '/vendor/erp/billing' — as soon as `navigate('/vendor/erp/billing')` fires in the useEffect on step change, ErpHub unmounts (React Router replaces the ErpHub element with ErpBilling), which unmounts <OnboardingTour/> too. The tour state (`step`, `running`) resets. Fix: hoist <OnboardingTour/> and useOnboardingTour into a route-persistent parent (Layout.jsx or App.js), or use a global provider + React portal so the overlay outlives route transitions.
